# Ryuk Design Studio — LLM Knowledge Base & Truth Engine

> Product Video Studio for SaaS, AI & Technology Companies. Make complex products feel obvious.

## Overview
Website Name: Ryuk Design Studio
Canonical URL: https://ryukdesignstudio.com/
Description: Ryuk Design Studio is a specialized product-video studio engineering high-impact launch films, product videos, software explainers, and campaign cutdowns for ambitious SaaS, AI, and technology companies.
Founded: 2025
Location: Kolkata, West Bengal, India (Serving Global Clients across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific)

## Positioning & Core Philosophy
- Core Proposition: "Make complex products feel obvious."
- Product First: We dig deep into technical architectures, product workflows, and value mechanics before opening any design tools.
- Story Before Style: Clarity drives motion. Visuals exist to explain value, accelerate comprehension, and compel buyer action.
- Cinematic by Default: High-end 3D product staging, interface choreography, physics-driven motion, and bespoke sound design.

## Core Capabilities & Formats
1. Launch Films: 30–60s flagship motion films for major product releases, funding rounds, and homepage hero reveals.
2. Product Videos: 60–90s feature choreography and end-to-end interface walkthroughs showcasing real user workflows in action.
3. Software Explainers: 60–90s problem-to-solution narrative films breaking down complex multi-step platforms into clear mental models.
4. Social & Campaign Cutdowns: 6–15s modular hooks, feature highlights, and performance ad cuts built for LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.
